<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function quietAssignSelfRightReview(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
class QuietAssignSelfReview {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $this; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$reader = new QuietAssignSelfReview;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietAssignSelfRightReview();
echo $answer !== null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "OWNED;" : "BAD_ROOT;";
unset($answer);
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietAssignPayloadReview {
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; throw new Exception("payload-assignment"); }
}
function quietAssignArrayRightReview(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
class QuietAssignArrayReview {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): array { global $reader, $selector; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return [new QuietAssignPayloadReview]; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-assignment"); }
}
$reader = new QuietAssignArrayReview;
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ??= quietAssignArrayRightReview(); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "changed" ? "NAME_CHANGED;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
